rotation_commentary.text: AM Best: BMO Life 'extending asset duration through diverse strategies'; longevity risk exposure 'significantly increased' with PRT growth; first international PRT transaction completed.
Insurance revenue +37% to 503 incl. gain on sale of a portfolio of insurance contracts (UV Insurance block); FVTPL securities backing liabilities up to 13,536 from 12,214.
BMO Insurance ranked leading Canadian PRT provider in 2025 (LIMRA data) and won the largest single-day Canadian PRT transaction, C$525mm (per BMO market outlook; company-reported).
June 2025: ~200,000-policy direct-marketing and par whole life block (~C$50mm premium) transferred to UV Insurance by assumption reinsurance - exits small legacy blocks.

structured_indirect.text: Derivatives notional (OSFI LF3, Oct 2025): FX 848.3; equity 234.4; fixed income linear 2,169.7.
Reinsurance ceded to independent reinsurers mitigates insurance risk; BMO Reinsurance Limited (Barbados-domiciled affiliate) publishes separate FS (Oct 31, 2025).

deals.text: BMO acquires AIG Life Insurance Company of Canada for ~C$308mm; becomes BMO Life Assurance (Peter McCarthy stays as CEO).
Yellow Pages buys annuities from BMO Life Assurance to transfer ~C$210mm of DB pension obligations (~50% of plan).
First international pension risk transfer transaction completed (AM Best, Jan 2025).

June 6, 2025: ~200,000 policies (180k direct-marketing A&S/term, 15k par whole life; ~C$50mm premiums) transferred to UV Insurance via OSFI-regulated assumption reinsurance; gain recognised FY2025. Advisers not named (Fasken acted for UV per its site).
Largest single-day Canadian PRT deal (C$525mm) won by BMO Insurance; leading PRT provider 2025 per LIMRA (company outlook).

bank_relationships.text: Bank-owned: creditor insurance via BMO bank channels; individual products via MGAs/advisors; PRT via consultants; BMO GAM manages seg-fund portfolios.
AM Best: no significant dividends to parent in prior three years; plans to pay dividends while maintaining target risk-adjusted capital.

appetite: Not published for BMO Life; managed within BMO's enterprise risk appetite. AM Best assesses ERM 'appropriate'; flags longevity risk from long-duration PRT business.
governance: CRO, BMO Insurance reports to CRO, Wealth Management (second line); internal risk committees and BMO Insurance subsidiary boards provide governance.
Risk Committee of BMO Insurance reports quarterly to the insurance companies' boards; reinsurance used to transfer/cede insurance risk.
risk.capital_target: Not disclosed; 'target risk-adjusted capital' maintained while paying dividends (AM Best). LICAT total 134% (Oct 31, 2025, OSFI).
sensitivities: None published for BMO Life; bank-level insurance risk sensitivities (interest rate, equity) sit in BMO's MD&A market-risk section (not extracted here).
hedging: Fixed-income derivatives notional 2,170 and FX 848 (OSFI LF3) consistent with duration extension and currency hedging for PRT/international business (inferred).
events: June 2025 block sale to UV Insurance (gain in FY2025 insurance revenue).
IFRS 17 adopted by bank Nov 1, 2023 (full retrospective); CSM 1,550 at transition, 1,210 remaining Oct 2025.
